", "explanation": "Add ConfigDict import needed for the v2 `model_config` declaration (migration.md#changes-to-config)."}, {"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/core.py:55:config-class"], "search": "    class Config:
        # allow_mutation: bool = False
        validate_all = True
        validate_assignment = True
", "replace": "    model_config = ConfigDict(
        # allow_mutation: bool = False
        validate_default=True,
        validate_assignment=True,
    )
", "explanation": "The v1 inner `class Config` is deprecated in favor of `model_config = ConfigDict(...)` (migration.md#changes-to-config). `validate_all` is renamed to `validate_default`, as listed in the renamed-settings table. `validate_assignment` is unchanged. The commented-out `allow_mutation` line is kept as-is since it is only a comment."}], "notes": "Two edits fix finding pydantic_cli/core.py:55:config-class: the ConfigDict import, and replacing the inner `class Config` on CliConfig with `model_config = ConfigDict(validate_default=True, validate_assignment=True)`. Not changed (out of scope for the listed finding): the `_get_cli_config_from_model` function still reads settings via `getattr(cls.Config, ...)`. That reads the Config of the user-supplied model class `cls`, not CliConfig, so it is a separate concern. Its behavior depends on how user models declare their config (v1-style `class Config` or v2 `model_config`), and the finding does not cover it. It should be reviewed in a follow-up, because under v2 user models that use `model_config` will not expose `cls.Config`. The CliConfig(...) construction and DefaultConfig are unchanged. Remaining file-level v1 items, if any, were not in the findings list."}
